MRI Safety Information
The Umbra Neuromodulation System is MR Conditional. A person with the Umbra Neuromodulation System may be safely scanned under the following conditions. Failure to follow these conditions may result in injury.
Parameter Condition
Device Name Umbra Neuromodulation System
Device Configuration Therapy OFF
Static Magnetic Field Strength (B0) 1.5-Tesla and 3-Tesla
Maximum Spatial Field Gradient 7.2 T/m (720 gauss/cm)
RF Excitation Circularly Polarized (CP)
RF Conditions For 1.5T MR Scanner: Whole-Body SAR ≤ 2 W/kg
For 3T MR Scanner: Maximum Whole-Body SAR 0.5 W/kg
Scan Regions Landmark the scan at least 30 cm away from the implanted pulse generator
Image Artifact The image artifact extends approximately 15 mm from the device.
RF heating was evaluated using a body coil at 64 MHz and 128 MHz in a gel phantom.
